goodsServices.description: Carpets, rugs, mats and matting, linoleum and other materials for covering existing floors; carpet underlay; floor coverings; carpet tiles and carpet runners; door mats; vinyl floor coverings and tiles; anti-slip materials for use under carpets, rugs and mats .

Retail services connected with the sale of floor coverings, carpets, rugs, mats and accessories therefor; the bringing together, for the benefit of others, of a variety of floorcoverings, carpets, rugs, mats, anti-slip materials, stair rods, door bars, threshold bars and trims, carpet grippers and beading, carpet tape, glues and adhesives, to enable consumers to conveniently view and purchase those goods from a website or physical store.

Maintenance, repair and installation services in the field of carpets, flooring and floor coverings; installation and fitting of carpets and flooring; carpet cleaning and stain removal services; application of underlay; repair and maintenance of flooring; estimating, planning and measuring services in relation to the provision of carpets and other floor coverings; information, advisory and consultancy services relating to the aforesaid.

Carpet and rug design services; development and design of manufacturing methods relating to carpets and floor coverings; testing, authentication and quality control of manufactured goods; certification services relating to carpets and floor coverings; information, advisory and consultancy services relating to the aforesaid.
